meta.name: hivemind-goals
meta.description: Create, track, and read team goals + KPIs via Hivemind from openclaw. Use whenever the user mentions a goal, objective, KPI, target, milestone, or asks to track progress on something measurable. ALSO use when the user says "task", "todo", "work item", "remind me to", "fix X", or any actionable work item — the goal system replaced the legacy `hivemind tasks` CLI and now covers both objectives and tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并追踪团队目标与关键成果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要统一管理目标和任务进度
copy.tagline_en: Create and track team goals and key results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs a unified way to manage goals and task progress

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以创建团队目标、添加关键指标（KPI），并记录待办任务。它还能搜索已有目标、读取完整内容，并在你要求时恢复之前暂停的任务上下文。
howto.when: 当你提到目标、KPI、里程碑、任务、待办事项、提醒等关键词，或要求跟踪可衡量的进展时触发。也适用于你说“修复 X”等具体工作项。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新目标：提升用户留存率。
say.note: Claude 会调用工具创建目标并返回 ID。

say.text: 给这个目标添加一个 KPI：每月活跃用户数达到 10 万。
say.note: Claude 会为已有目标添加 KPI。

say.text: 保存这个任务：优化数据库查询，稍后继续。
say.note: Claude 会存储任务上下文，包括起始步骤、文件路径等。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create team goals, add KPIs, and record tasks. It can also search existing goals, read full content, and resume previously parked task context when asked.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention goals, KPIs, milestones, tasks, todos, reminders, or ask to track measurable progress. Also when you say "fix X" or similar actionable work items.

say_en.text: Create a new goal: improve user retention.
say_en.note: Claude will create the goal and return its ID.

say_en.text: Add a KPI to this goal: 100k monthly active users.
say_en.note: Claude will add the KPI to the existing goal.

say_en.text: Save this task: optimize database queries, resume later.
say_en.note: Claude will store the task context including start steps, file paths, etc.
